audience: Shoppers choosing a simple guest-bath finishing touch
hook: One small detail for the guest sink
script: Introduce the product as an idea for the guest sink. Use the original product photo for a slow crop and finish on the shop link. No cleaning or skin-effect promises.
static_layout: Original bar on a warm neutral background with generous negative space. A small contextual sink inset must be an owned photograph; do not fabricate product placement.

shots.visual: Use exact original product photo; frame the flecked surface with a restrained crop.
shots.overlay: One small detail for the guest sink

shots.visual: Slowly reveal the complete original bar. Preserve shape and star embossing; no synthetic product motion.
Hold the real product image with a small brand credit and clear CTA.

audio.direction: Use a quiet, owned recording of the real product being placed on a surface. No added fake production sounds; request recording before render.
